claims.claim: Observation in drawing means looking at actual relationships rather than relying on a symbolic idea of an object. Positive space contains the subject; negative space surrounds or sits between its parts. Both contribute to the composition. Drawing a gap can reveal alignment errors because the gap has a shape of its own. Contours describe boundaries, not every interior detail. These are drawing methods, not claims about artistic worth or a preferred style.

locators.limitations: Not universal criteria for artistic worth
